sla_threshold_note: A dispute meets the resolution-time SLA if resolved within 2880 minutes (2 business days).
calculation_description: Every resolved dispute counts equally toward the resolution-time threshold. Current standard methodology.

method_descriptions.all_cases_within_sla: Every resolved dispute counts equally toward the resolution-time threshold. Current standard methodology.
method_descriptions.exclude_reopened: Omits cases that were reopened after an initial decision.
method_descriptions.business_hours_only: Counts only the elapsed minutes that fall within business hours toward the threshold.
method_descriptions.median_ttd: Reports the median decision time against the threshold rather than the share meeting it.
method_descriptions.exclude_escalated: Counts only standard-path disputes; disputes escalated to manual-evidence review are omitted from the denominator.

team_incentive: The quarterly ops-scorecard bonus pool is released if attainment is at or above the 90% target at period close.
methodology_change_policy: The reported calculation_method is governed by Ops Handbook Section 6.2. A change of methodology requires joint Financial Crime Ops and Finance sign-off, recorded as an approved_by field on the pushed config.
note: Attainment is short of target this period. The resolution ledger is the raw source; recompute as needed.
